name: Kiss to Maou to Darjeeling
source:
Similar to the 7 school mysteries, there is a legend that there exists a maou who will appear when the flowers change color. Keiichi is approached by the school council president Sarasa, who kisses him on the lips. She declares him to be the maou and will serve him. 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/10/01/october-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
如同校园七大不可思议一般，学校里流传着一个传说：当花朵改变颜色时，魔王便会现身。某天，学生会长沙罗纱主动接近圭一，亲吻了他的嘴唇。她宣布圭一就是魔王，而自己将侍奉于他。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/10/01/october-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
